list.name: assessment
list.query: SELECT assessment_id::text AS __value, created_at::text || ' ' || scope || ' ' || status AS __text FROM data_eligibility_assessments WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND (${scope:sqlstring} = '__all' OR scope = ${scope:sqlstring}) AND (${model:sqlstring} = '' OR model_id = ${model:sqlstring}) AND (${run:sqlstring} = '' OR run_id::text = ${run:sqlstring}) AND (${loop:sqlstring} = '' OR report #>> '{loop_context,loop_id}' = ${loop:sqlstring}) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 500

options.content: Training excludes failing symbols from both splits; strict mode rejects the attempt. Backtest checks only warn and never change replay membership. Missing bars do not prove delisting, merger or halt. Historical listing/actions are unknown. Validation availability conditions the training cohort; this is not an unbiased point-in-time universe. Legacy models/runs without a report are **not assessed**, not zero exclusions. Summary counts apply to assessment filters; symbol/reason filters apply to detail tables.

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.created_at, a.assessment_id::text, a.scope, a.status, a.config_hash, a.report #>> '{universe_metadata,bucket}' AS bucket, a.report->>'outcome' AS outcome, jsonb_array_length(a.report->'requested_symbols') AS requested, CASE WHEN a.status = 'error' THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_array_length(a.report->'effective_symbols') END AS retained, (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.report->'symbols') s WHERE s->>'decision' = 'excluded') AS excluded, (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.report->'symbols') s WHERE s->>'decision' = 'excluded')::float / NULLIF(jsonb_array_length(a.report->'requested_symbols'), 0) AS exclusion_rate, a.model_id, a.run_id::text, a.report #>> '{loop_context,loop_id}' AS loop_id, a.report->>'error' AS error FROM data_eligibility_assessments a WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND (${scope:sqlstring} = '__all' OR a.scope = ${scope:sqlstring}) AND (${assessment:sqlstring} = '__all' OR a.assessment_id::text = ${assessment:sqlstring}) AND (${model:sqlstring} = '' OR a.model_id = ${model:sqlstring}) AND (${run:sqlstring} = '' OR a.run_id::text = ${run:sqlstring}) AND (${loop:sqlstring} = '' OR a.report #>> '{loop_context,loop_id}' = ${loop:sqlstring}) ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT a.assessment_id::text, s->>'symbol' AS symbol, s->>'decision' AS decision, w.key AS split, (w.value->>'usable_rows')::int AS usable_rows, (w.value->>'expected_rows')::int AS expected_rows, (w.value->>'usable_coverage')::float AS usable_coverage, (w.value->>'raw_coverage')::float AS raw_coverage, (w.value->>'feature_ready_rows')::int AS feature_ready_rows, w.value->>'first_bar' AS first_bar, w.value->>'last_bar' AS last_bar, (w.value->>'missing_sessions')::int AS missing_sessions, (w.value->>'longest_missing_session_run')::int AS longest_missing_session_run, w.value->>'rejections' AS row_rejections, s->>'reasons' AS reasons_and_thresholds, a.report->>'policy' AS policy, COALESCE(s->>'trained', 'unknown / legacy') AS trained, a.report #>> '{reference_data,listing_as_of}' AS listing_as_of, a.report #>> '{reference_data,corporate_actions}' AS corporate_actions FROM data_eligibility_assessments a CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(a.report->'symbols') s CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(s->'windows') w WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND (${scope:sqlstring} = '__all' OR a.scope = ${scope:sqlstring}) AND (${assessment:sqlstring} = '__all' OR a.assessment_id::text = ${assessment:sqlstring}) AND (${model:sqlstring} = '' OR a.model_id = ${model:sqlstring}) AND (${run:sqlstring} = '' OR a.run_id::text = ${run:sqlstring}) AND (${loop:sqlstring} = '' OR a.report #>> '{loop_context,loop_id}' = ${loop:sqlstring}) AND (${symbol:sqlstring} = '' OR s->>'symbol' = ${symbol:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(s->'reasons') r WHERE r->>'code' = ${reason:sqlstring} AND r->>'split' = w.key)) ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, symbol, split LIMIT 5000

panels.title: Reasons by split — distinct symbols per assessment

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.scope, r->>'split' AS split, r->>'code' AS reason, count(DISTINCT (a.assessment_id, s->>'symbol')) AS symbols FROM data_eligibility_assessments a CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(a.report->'symbols') s CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(s->'reasons') r WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND (${scope:sqlstring} = '__all' OR a.scope = ${scope:sqlstring}) AND (${assessment:sqlstring} = '__all' OR a.assessment_id::text = ${assessment:sqlstring}) AND (${model:sqlstring} = '' OR a.model_id = ${model:sqlstring}) AND (${run:sqlstring} = '' OR a.run_id::text = ${run:sqlstring}) AND (${loop:sqlstring} = '' OR a.report #>> '{loop_context,loop_id}' = ${loop:sqlstring}) AND (${symbol:sqlstring} = '' OR s->>'symbol' = ${symbol:sqlstring}) AND (${reason:sqlstring} = '' OR r->>'code' = ${reason:sqlstring}) GROUP BY a.scope, r->>'split', r->>'code' ORDER BY symbols DESC

SELECT a.assessment_id::text, a.status, a.report->>'global_reasons' AS global_reasons, a.report->>'context' AS benchmark_evidence, a.report->>'error' AS error FROM data_eligibility_assessments a WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND (${scope:sqlstring} = '__all' OR a.scope = ${scope:sqlstring}) AND (${assessment:sqlstring} = '__all' OR a.assessment_id::text = ${assessment:sqlstring}) AND (${model:sqlstring} = '' OR a.model_id = ${model:sqlstring}) AND (${run:sqlstring} = '' OR a.run_id::text = ${run:sqlstring}) AND (${loop:sqlstring} = '' OR a.report #>> '{loop_context,loop_id}' = ${loop:sqlstring}) ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 500
